tagline: Jev takes aim at a sliding target, planting every arrow in the bullseye, live

examples.prompt: Set Jev Archer up for a hard range — speed the target up so it slides faster than Jev's aim can correct. Give Jev a lead-the-motion aiming style, then watch it read the target every tick, nudge the aim to track, and release arrow after arrow into (or past) the bullseye.
examples.caption: Jev's Day on the Range — a fast decision model tracking the sliding target and planting the bullseye on each shot
